::: {#exr-bayes}

#### Turn a conditional around

@def-conditional-prob defines $\Pr(A \mid B)$ in terms of $\Pr(A \cap B)$.
Write the same definition with $A$ and $B$ swapped,
then eliminate $\Pr(A \cap B)$ between the two.

Your result should express $\Pr(A \mid B)$ using $\Pr(B \mid A)$, $\Pr(A)$ and
$\Pr(B)$, and none of them jointly.

:::
